plain_italian_summary: Questa bozza definisce come evitare che il go-live crei lavoro umano accumulato o costi non controllati. Non attiva pagamenti, non contatta clienti, non usa dati reali e non modifica limiti live.
goals: keep owner daily supervision below 30 minutes in normal conditions
avoid work accumulation if owner is absent for a few days
stop or slow down usage before cost spikes
make support responses readable by machines
escalate only critical decisions to the owner

automatic_responses.machine_response: Return structured error with missing_fields, expected_schema and retry_allowed=true.
Return credit balance, product_code needed and blocked_purchase_reason. No automatic paid top-up until commercial gate passes.
Return duplicate_request=true and previous_result_reference without consuming extra credits.
Return commercial_go_live_blocked=true and explain that paid activation requires owner approval and fiscal/billing gates.
Return real_data_blocked=true and do not process payload.

owner_absence_behavior: do not retry failing write operations
summarize only top 3 items requiring decision

owner_escalation_rules: payment, invoice or fiscal decision requested
real customer data or personal data appears
external contact or outreach is requested

commercial_margin_rules.required_before_live: estimate cost per valid target and require minimum gross margin before paid sale
estimate cost per valid score and require retry/idempotency protection
estimate cost per report and enforce no-credit on invalid output
estimate cost per action pack and require Deep Analysis gate

stop_triggers: HTTP 429 from Cloudflare, Worker, KV or public API
Cloudflare KV write usage above soft limit
external paid API call attempted without budget approval
personal or real customer data detected in test mode
unexpected 5xx repeated three times on critical endpoints
automatic_actions: do not retry costly action automatically

agent_responsibilities.responsibility: Apply stop triggers, coordinate owner escalation and keep roadmap status updated.
Maintain automatic support responses and no-work-accumulation queue.
Track cost assumptions, margin rules and billing blockers.
Stop real data, personal data, payment and outreach requests until approved.
Keep error codes, usage, orders and product gates machine-readable.

recommended_next_action.name: support_cost_guard_probe_and_margin_model
recommended_next_action.plain_italian: Validare questa bozza e poi preparare un modello di margine minimo per prodotto, senza attivare pagamenti o chiamate paid esterne.
